parts.question: What is the current renal starting dose of AX-17?

result.answer:
The current renal starting doses of AX-17 in Germany are as follows:
*   Normal renal function (eGFR >=90): 50 mg OD [E2]
*   Mild renal impairment (eGFR 60-89): 50 mg OD [E2]
*   Moderate renal impairment (eGFR 30-59): 25 mg OD [E1, E2, E3]
*   Severe renal impairment (eGFR 15-29): Specialist review [E2]
